description:
Designer & management software for xTool laser cutters & engravers.


General
1. Add Project Notes — save your tips and cautions with the project, shown automatically on reopen or before processing so you don't repeat mistakes (.xs files only)
2. Upgrade My Space — adds a Local Space to quickly manage local projects / assets, bringing cloud, local, and favorite assets together in one place

Editor
1. Add Warp — bend, arch, distort, and apply perspective to text and images using preset shapes or custom parameters
2. Add Pattern Fill — fill shapes with image patterns in multiple layouts for quick repeating textures (M2 & printing devices only)
3. Rebuild node editing — split into dedicated Select / Add / Delete / Break tools for clearer, faster path editing
4. Add Segment Trim — clean up extra segments between crossing paths in one click
5. Set Elements as Variables — element content auto-updates from list data, so one layout can batch-produce different designs — ideal for jig workflows
6. Optimize the canvas user experience — objects turn semi-transparent while moving, rotating, or scaling for easier alignment. Zooming supports automatic snapping
7. Improve Offset - add an adjustable precision option for balancing speed and detail

Material Parameters
1. Support local storage & offline use — save and use material parameters even without a network connection
2. Upgrade Material Management — two-way local–cloud sync, plus import, export, batch delete, and new .mxs export (parameters + result images)
3. Add Parameter Sharing — share saved or just-used parameter settings; featured shares may appear in the Material Parameters section on the Home page for others to reference

Devices
1. Support the all-new multifunction printer: xTool O1 omni printer
2. Support multi-device workflow — print-then-cut between the O1 and P3, M1 Ultra, and S1 (P2S, P2, M2 coming soon)
3. M2: Add one-click cutting contours — instantly assign irregular, rectangular, circular, or heart shapes to bitmaps / vectors, all editable afterward
4. M2: Support per-element air pump flow — flow controls moved to the parameter panel, configurable per machining element (firmware 40.141.010.3 or later)
5. P3: Support one-click video editing & sharing — auto-edit recorded processing videos and share to Instagram, Facebook, etc.
6. F2: Support Auto Mode — after closing the lid, auto-focus, refresh background, recognize the material QR code, and center canvas elements within the material outline — truly place-and-create (firmware v024 or later)
7. Add real-time rotary preview — with RA3 auto-modeling on P3/M2, a mini-window shows the design's position on the object in real time, with a centerline guide for easier alignment
8. Improve flat preview — cutting now shows the true cut-through result, plus a Layer Selector and Exploded View for complex designs and thickness info in material preview
9. Add glass inner-engraving preview

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed a crash when extracting contours in certain cases
2. Fixed a processing-mode mismatch when importing Keychain Generator designs into Studio
3. Fixed slow file transfer on the Apparel Printer in certain cases
4. Fixed slow estimated-time generation for certain files
5. Fixed other known issues
